data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Add RED test for ImportError exit-7 path. Spec: stub the python -c subprocess to raise ImportError (e.g., remove bridge_fsck module from sys.path); invoke audit_dd1_baseline.sh; assert exit code == 7 + stderr diagnostic identifies the missing API. Also add RED test for fallback regex path: provide fixture file containing representative bridge-fsck human-readable report; assert extracted count matches expected value. Mark fallback test with 'fallback-path' tag.
